original.target_description: Problem 5a and Problem 5b both assess overtime to remove a sales shortfall versus exceed a sales goal; supplied description and p. 10 locator do not distinguish the two tests.

notes: Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no extraction attempted for them. Primary source identity verified by title, authors, journal, year and Article ID. Candidate Problem 5a: N=61, median-implied coefficient of loss aversion 2.5; 99% CI around mean coefficient [2.30, 3.85]. Candidate Problem 5b: separate participant group N=57, median-implied coefficient 2, 99% CI [1.37, 2.74]. No assignment of these two problems to audit IDs is justified by the identical neutral locators. No sample sum: these are separate problems, not groups in a common critical test. No p value is printed for either coefficient; CIs are not converted to p values.
